prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical 3:4 candid analog portrait of three adult Japanese people inside a small dimly lit vintage bar. At center, an adult Japanese woman with a chestnut-brown ponytail and straight bangs wears a fitted light-blue police uniform shirt with gold buttons and badge, dark green ribbon tie, navy skirt, dark belt, white gloves, and black shoes. She sits calmly on a narrow wooden bench with knees together and gloved hands gently folded above a small tumbler, chin slightly lowered and looking toward the camera. Two older Japanese policemen in period uniforms flank her: the left officer leans inward from the doorway with one elbow on his knee, while the right officer sits with arms crossed and a reserved expression. Shoot from the doorway so worn wooden jambs form a frame around the trio. Fill the bar with vintage Japanese posters, handwritten slips, old bottles, glassware, cords, utensils, cluttered shallow shelves, scuffed varnished beams, and faint lacquer reflections. Use one or two bare tungsten bulbs at approximately 2800K for localized amber pools that fade rapidly into darkness. Eye-level 35mm focal feel at close conversational distance, low-saturation color, fine 35mm grain, slightly overexposed highlights, shallow depth of field, and a retro 1980s Japanese street-photography snapshot aesthetic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed
